bosses.name: Vardorvis

attacks.name: head
attacks.evidence: measured, n=4: gaze landed, small, no heal

attacks.name: melee
attacks.evidence: certain: melee anim a tick before

bosses.notes: Strength and defence move linearly from full hitpoints to none (DPS calc scaling/Vardorvis.ts). The stats file stores both as 0. Defence cannot be drained (DPS calc DefenceReduction.ts floor = current defence). attacksOnPlayer (T-041): from T-039's 23 kills of Eric's 2026-10-27 logs and the OSRS Wiki's Vardorvis and Vardorvis/Strategies pages (read 2026-10-27); every id in it was seen in those logs. Melee and spikes heal him half the hit, axes and his head's gaze do not; an axe's bleed (splat 67) follows it within 6 ticks; Protect from Melee lets a quarter of his melee through, at most 10. A failed strangle has never been logged, so it is not named: it counts as chip until a log shows it. Defence drains: immune by the DPS calc (DefenceReduction.ts floor = current defence) and the wiki's Vardorvis/Strategies ('defence-draining weapons are useless'); the wiki also quotes Mod Ash saying they do work, though not to zero, so this is unsettled (T-049).

states.name: enraged
states.source: T-091. OSRS Wiki, read 2026-10-29: Araxxor/Strategies: 'When Araxxor falls below 255 health, he will enter an enrage phase' (Araxxor: 'When Araxxor reaches 25% health, he enters an enrage phase'), and it lasts 'for the remainder of the fight'. The signal is his enrage animation: RuneLite 1.13.4's gamevals name 11488 and 11489 NPC_ARAXXOR_01_ENRAGE_TRANSITION_01 and _02, and 11487 NPC_ARAXXOR_01_ATTACK_MELEE_ENRAGED_01, the cleave that replaces his melee once enraged (so a missed transition still opens it at his first cleave). Eric's log of 2026-10-29 (pvm-debug-20261029-171127), the second attempt: 11488 at [8030] on the tick his bar fell from 279 to 217, 11489 at [8032], then 11487 every 4 ticks from [8035]; in the kill, 11487 every 4 ticks from [7649] at 212 hp, where 11480 (NPC_ARAXXOR_01_ATTACK_MELEE_01) came every 6 before [7628] at 256. No end: it is open until he dies (the tracker forgets him at his despawn).

modifiers.name: enraged
modifiers.source: T-091. The DPS calc's scaling/Phases.ts: Araxxor's 'Enraged' phase adds 35 Defence, 28 Magic and 31 Ranged levels; OSRS Wiki, read 2026-10-29: Araxxor: 'his Defence level increases by 35' (135 to 170; the infobox's 190/218 Magic and 210/241 Ranged agree with the calc). Drains carry over (Araxxor/Strategies: 'drained stats will carry over to enrage'), so a drain comes off the enraged level. hiddenLive, the Jagex rule: a live change at the enrage would announce it, so only the scoring takes it.

defenceDrain.source: OSRS Wiki, read 2026-10-28: Araxxor/Strategies: 'His Defence level can be only drained by up to 45 levels'; 'drained stats will carry over to enrage' (the enrage is a form change: drains carry). DPS calc floor 90 agrees.

bosses.name: The Royal Titans
bosses.notes: T-120. Branda (12596) and Eldric (14147) fighting; 14148 and 14149 are their beaten forms. Ranged and magic defence +700 (light, standard, heavy), stab and slash +12, crush 0, Defence 100 (wiki infoboxes; the DPS calc's monsters.json agrees). Their elemental weaknesses (Branda water 50%, Eldric fire 50%) are in monsters.json and applied by CombatCalc to a spell of that element, accuracy and damage.

states.name: elemental blast
states.source: T-120. OSRS Wiki, read 2026-10-30: Branda the Fire Queen: 'the player's ranged accuracy is increased by 500% (x6) whenever she is out of melee distance, and lasts until she moves back within melee distance'; 'This boost also applies during the entirety of the Titans' Elemental Blast attack, which includes the charging portion.' Eldric the Ice King says the same of him. Royal Titans/Strategies: 'players get a hidden +500% (a 6x multiplier) to ranged accuracy whenever the titans are out of melee distance'; in phase 2, 'the player's ranged accuracy gets a 6x multiplier during the charging, attack, and for a few seconds after'. The animations, from RuneLite 1.13.4's gamevals: 11979 ICE_GIANT_EDRIC_KING_ATTACK_AOE01 and 11980 _AOE02 (Eldric), 11981 FIRE_GIANT_BRANDA_QUEEN_ATTACK_AOE01 and 11982 _AOE02 (Branda). Eric's log of 2026-10-30 10:30 (pvm-debug-20261030-103025, build 4f6ca3c): Eldric 11979 at [7353], 11980 at [7359], idle at [7366]; again [7382]/[7388], and [7411]/[7417]/[7423]; Branda 11981 at [7295], 11982 at [7301]. Read as the charge (AOE01, 6 ticks) and the three blasts (AOE02, 6-7 ticks): 12-13 ticks in all, and the wiki's 'few seconds after' taken as 3 ticks more, 16 from the charge. The 3 is a guess, for the MOD lines to settle.

modifiers.name: out of melee distance
modifiers.source: T-120. OSRS Wiki, read 2026-10-30: Branda the Fire Queen: 'the player's ranged accuracy is increased by 500% (x6) whenever she is out of melee distance, and lasts until she moves back within melee distance'; 'This boost also applies during the entirety of the Titans' Elemental Blast attack, which includes the charging portion.' Eldric the Ice King says the same of him. Royal Titans/Strategies: 'players get a hidden +500% (a 6x multiplier) to ranged accuracy whenever the titans are out of melee distance'; in phase 2, 'the player's ranged accuracy gets a 6x multiplier during the charging, attack, and for a few seconds after'. The DPS calc (c1f7737) has an 'In Melee Range' / 'Out of Melee Range' phase toggle on both titans, and multiplies the ranged attack roll by 6/1 out of melee range, last; it does not model the blast. Out of melee distance is read as the player not on a tile cardinally next to the titan's footprint, from which it could melee them, on the attack's throw tick: a reading, not a source. Live (D-2, 2026-10-28): it follows the player's own position, as the Leviathan's behind and pathfinder rules do.

modifiers.name: elemental blast
modifiers.source: T-120. OSRS Wiki, read 2026-10-30: Branda the Fire Queen: 'the player's ranged accuracy is increased by 500% (x6) whenever she is out of melee distance, and lasts until she moves back within melee distance'; 'This boost also applies during the entirety of the Titans' Elemental Blast attack, which includes the charging portion.' Eldric the Ice King says the same of him. Royal Titans/Strategies: 'players get a hidden +500% (a 6x multiplier) to ranged accuracy whenever the titans are out of melee distance'; in phase 2, 'the player's ranged accuracy gets a 6x multiplier during the charging, attack, and for a few seconds after'. In melee distance, during this titan's own blast (from its charge), judged on the throw tick; out of melee distance the rule above already has the x6, so the two never stack. Whether a blast by one titan boosts a shot at the other isn't said: each titan's own is taken. Live (D-2): the state opens on the animation the player sees.

modifiers.name: noxious halberd
modifiers.source: T-098. OSRS Wiki, read 2026-10-29: Araxxor/Strategies: 'Players will always max hit when attacking the hatched araxytes with a noxious halberd, crush weapons, or heavy Ranged weapon (such as a crossbow or ballista) if crush or ranged is their highest accuracy style respectively. Attacking the hatched eggs with anything else - or attacking the unhatched eggs - does not guarantee a max hit, and rolls damage normally.' Mirrorback Araxyte says the same. The wiki doesn't say the attack can't miss, nor what 'highest accuracy style' is: both are the DPS calc's reading (PlayerVsNPCCalc at c1f7737: accuracy 1 and a single hit at the max, against the Acidic and Mirrorback; the highest of the worn attack bonuses). Eric's log of 2026-10-29 21:20 (pvm-debug-20261029-212024): every Hunters' sunlight crossbow shot at an Acidic or Mirrorback landed, at its max or at the hitpoints left. The noxious halberd and its Bounty Hunter copy (gamevals NOXIOUS_HALBERD, BR_NOXIOUS_HALBERD).

defenceDrain.source: OSRS Wiki, read 2026-10-28: Yama/Strategies: 'his stats can be drained a maximum of 80 Defence levels (to 145)'. Contracted fights are immune (Temporary skill drain); a contract is not detected, so not modelled.

modifiers.name: phase 3
modifiers.source: T-135. OSRS Wiki, read 2026-10-31: Yama/Strategies: 'If his primary target attacks him with magic, his magic defence will significantly increase from -30 to +60'; 'If the player currently targeted by Yama is using magic during phase 1 and 2, his magic defence raises to 60'; phase 3: 'Yama will position himself in the centre of the arena and increase his defence bonuses' ('+81 magic defence'); the phases end 'Upon reaching 66.6% and 33.3% of his health (not a hard cap)', phase 3 beginning once the Judge is killed. The DPS calc (c1f7737): scaling/Phases.ts sets Yama's magic defence to 60 for 'Tank using magic' and -30 otherwise, outside its 'Phase 3' version (monsters.json: Normal magic +0; Phase 3 magic +81, crush 449, stab 135, slash 108, ranged 297/449). The signal: his hitpoints at or below a third when the attack goes out. He can't be attacked through the intermission, so that is phase 3, but for the hit that takes him past the third (the threshold is 'not a hard cap'). No animation or id marks it (RuneLite 1.13.4's gamevals: his NPC_YAMA01_* are the same throughout). Eric's log of 2026-10-31 (pvm-debug-20261031-140202, build 2d9270f): both kills' last flares spawned with him at 229 and 305, after their second Judge.

modifiers.name: tank uses magic
modifiers.source: T-135. OSRS Wiki, read 2026-10-31: Yama/Strategies: 'If his primary target attacks him with magic, his magic defence will significantly increase from -30 to +60'; 'If the player currently targeted by Yama is using magic during phase 1 and 2, his magic defence raises to 60'; phase 3: 'Yama will position himself in the centre of the arena and increase his defence bonuses' ('+81 magic defence'); the phases end 'Upon reaching 66.6% and 33.3% of his health (not a hard cap)', phase 3 beginning once the Judge is killed. The DPS calc (c1f7737): scaling/Phases.ts sets Yama's magic defence to 60 for 'Tank using magic' and -30 otherwise, outside its 'Phase 3' version (monsters.json: Normal magic +0; Phase 3 magic +81, crush 449, stab 135, slash 108, ranged 297/449). The tank is the player Yama is interacting with: the local player by the attack style in hand, a partner by their weapon's highest attack bonus being magic (a reading of 'attacks him with magic', not a source). Neither when he targets no player: then the Normal's +0.

modifiers.name: tank not using magic
modifiers.source: T-135. OSRS Wiki, read 2026-10-31: Yama/Strategies: 'If his primary target attacks him with magic, his magic defence will significantly increase from -30 to +60'; 'If the player currently targeted by Yama is using magic during phase 1 and 2, his magic defence raises to 60'; phase 3: 'Yama will position himself in the centre of the arena and increase his defence bonuses' ('+81 magic defence'); the phases end 'Upon reaching 66.6% and 33.3% of his health (not a hard cap)', phase 3 beginning once the Judge is killed. The DPS calc (c1f7737): scaling/Phases.ts sets Yama's magic defence to 60 for 'Tank using magic' and -30 otherwise, outside its 'Phase 3' version (monsters.json: Normal magic +0; Phase 3 magic +81, crush 449, stab 135, slash 108, ranged 297/449). As 'tank uses magic', the other way.

states.name: phase change
states.source: T-137, from T-136's measure. Yama's intermission: the animation 12147 at about two-thirds and a third of his hitpoints, until the Judge of Yama can be attacked. Eric, 2026-10-31: Yama can't be attacked between it and the Judge ('No you cannot'). Eric's log of 2026-10-31 (pvm-debug-20261031-140202, build 2d9270f), 12 windows in 6 kills: 12147 at 1,597-1,634 and 688-813 hitpoints left, no splat landing on him inside 11 of them, Eric's first throw at the Judge 15-18 ticks after it. 18 ticks is the most. No damage modifier rides on it: it is the window for its uptime allowance.

uptimeAllowances.source: T-137, approved by Eric 2026-10-31 (T-136's proposal). Yama can't be attacked from 12147 until the Judge comes. Measured over the same log's 12 windows, the ticks still lost in each from the animation to the first throw at the Judge once T-136's booking fixes are in: 10, 10, 11, 11, 13, 13, 13, 14, 14, 14, 15, 15 (median 13, 75th percentile 14). The cap is the 75th percentile, as T-074 and T-084 set theirs.

bosses.name: Void Flare
bosses.notes: T-135. Yama's Void Flares: 140 hp (the DPS calc's Fire and Shadow versions), 200% demonbane vulnerability (GearBonusCalc).

Phase 3 read as Yama's rule has it, from the boss bar: the HUD names Yama (npc 14176) while the player is on a flare (Eric's log of 2026-10-31 (pvm-debug-20261031-140202, build 2d9270f): at [7943] 229/2500, [8391] 305/2500, both flares dying to one 71; at [8095] 2032/2500, the flare taking 77 + 62).

bosses.name: Judge of Yama
bosses.notes: T-135. Its fights are unscored (T-136's call): this is its expected for when they are.

roomDamage.name: its own fireball
roomDamage.label: hit itself
roomDamage.tip: the Judge's fireball hitting itself when you stand under it (Eric's read)
roomDamage.source: T-137. Eric, 2026-10-31: 'If you step under the judge it hits itself with a fireball.' Its attack animation is 69, every 5 ticks. Eric's solo log of 2026-10-31 18:00 (pvm-debug-20261031-180053, build 4c6b379): 21 type-17 or type-13 splats on the Judge with no other player there, 14-18 (and two 0s), 5 ticks apart, 19 of them on a tick the Judge started 69. His duo log of 14:02 (pvm-debug-20261031-140202): 36 splats not his on the Judge on a tick it started 69, 30 of them 13-18 (the rest, 42-54, the partner's). The amounts are the logs' range; the wiki doesn't give the fireball's damage.

modifiers.name: guaranteed max
modifiers.source: T-135. OSRS Wiki, read 2026-10-31: Judge of Yama: 'Attacks made on the judge always land as both successful and maximum hits'; it prays against the last style used ('so two forms of combat are required'), which isn't read here, so an attack into its prayer would be scored at the max too. The DPS calc (c1f7737) has 14180 in ALWAYS_MAX_HIT_MONSTERS for every style. Eric's log of 2026-10-31 (pvm-debug-20261031-140202, build 2d9270f): 45 of Eric's 50 splats on it max-hit splats (type 43), none a 0.

bosses.name: Abyssal Sire
bosses.notes: Ids per version from the wiki's Abyssal Sire page (id1 = 5886,5887,5888; id2 = 5889,5890; id3 = 5891; id4 = 5908); the DPS calc's data lists only 5886, 5889, 5891 and 5908. Stage 2 has half the defence bonuses. Phase 1: any damage only counts towards disorienting it, and it is restored to full health by the end of the phase (wiki, Abyssal Sire/Strategies); in Eric's 10 kills of 2026-10-27 everything after phase 1 came to 425-452 whatever phase 1 took (0-100). The 0-27 over 425 is not explained (not the 50% transition reduction, not damage taken); the margin covers it so the last attacks are not capped short. Not modelled: if it reaches 0 before phase 2 it starts at 40%, before phase 3 at 20% (wiki). XP: all 42 clean melee drops on stage 2 decode at x1.125 to the splats they paid for, as on the other phases; 25 of them do not at the x1.100 the formula gives on stage 2's stats.

modifiers.name: walking
modifiers.source: OSRS Wiki, read 2026-10-28: Abyssal Sire: 'Damage dealt to the Sire while it is transitioning between phases is reduced by 50%' (changelog: 'introduced a 50% damage reduction during its transition phases'). The DPS calc halves it (divisionTransformer(2), rounding down). The form is 5889 (ABYSSALSIRE_SIRE_PUPPET), stepping out at the start of phase 2 and walking south at the start of phase 3, as Eric's logs show: in the 10 kills of 2026-10-27 and the 2 of 2026-10-28 no hit on 5889 was above half the attack's max (16 landed, the most 28 against a max of 57-61), where on 5890 they reach the max. 5891 (phase 3, standing) took 39 of a 49 max and 41 of 61, so it is not halved.

states.name: diving
states.source: T-084: Zulrah sinking (SNAKEBOSS_SINKFAST, 5072) to its emerging (SNAKEBOSS_EMERGEFAST, 5073), when it can't be attacked. Eric's log of 2026-10-29 06:12: 5072 then 5073 three ticks later at each of 7 dives where both show, the form changing on the emerge's tick. No damage modifier rides on it: it is the window for its uptime allowance.

uptimeAllowances.source: T-084, approved by Eric 2026-10-29 (cap 8). Zulrah's dives between forms, and getting into position and switching gear for the next form after it emerges. Measured over the same log's 26 counted dives in 5 Zulrah fights (each placed at its emerge: the form change, or 5073 where the form stays; the dive 3 ticks before), idle ticks from the dive to 6 after the emerge: median 6.5, 75th percentile 8, 90th 8.5, most 10. The cap is the 75th percentile. Checked on the log's 5 later kills by the Orchestrator, with a looser measure (idle ticks between the last attack before each dive and the first after, 25 dives): median 7, 75th percentile 8, mostly 4-10.

chaseByDistance.source: T-097, PROPOSED, for Eric to approve. After a burrow, once she is back in view, the run to her is excused for the ticks running takes to bring her within the weapon's reach, at 2 tiles a tick (Eric, 2026-10-29: she 'can burrow very far away or very close randomly'), plus this margin: a tick to see her and click, one for the path to start, one for the swing. A guess until measured: the next kill's CHASE lines give each chase's distance, reach and ticks taken, and the margin becomes the 75th percentile of the ticks beyond the run, as T-074 set its caps.

states.name: burrowed
states.source: T-088: the Giant Mole burrowing (MOLE_BURROW_DOWN 3314) to come up elsewhere in the lair (MOLE_BURROW_UP 3315), gamevals. OSRS Wiki, Giant Mole: 'While between 50% and 5% of her health, every attack from the player has a 25% chance of causing her to burrow into the ground' and move to 'another area in the lair'. The 100-tick limit is a backstop for a surfacing never seen.

uptimeAllowances.source: T-088, T-097, PROPOSED, for Eric to approve. The dig: idle ticks while she is still in view burrowing, before she is gone (out of view nothing counts, and the run back to her is chaseByDistance's). 5 is a guess at the dig's length: the burrow animation has not been logged yet. Re-measure from the next kill's BOSS ANIM and OUT OF VIEW lines.

states.name: stunned
states.source: OSRS Wiki, read 2026-10-28: The Leviathan/Strategies: 'players can cast any type of shadow spell to stun the Leviathan, where it will stay still for 15 ticks (9 seconds)'; The Leviathan: 'which will always succeed'; a shot into the wound 'will cause it to retaliate with a special attack' (The Leviathan: 'The Leviathan will break out of its stun when this occurs'). Awakened stuns are 'are 50% shorter': not modelled, the awakened fight sharing the id. The stun is timed from the player's own cast landing (an ancient cast animation with a shadow spell named; T-066 measured 10092 in Eric's 2026-10-29 log). resetsAttackDelay (T-078): The Leviathan/Strategies, 'Stunning the Leviathan resets the player's attack delay, allowing for a free ranged shot every stun before Levi's damage reduction kicks in'; Eric's 2026-10-29 00:34 log has the bow firing the tick after each cast, its 22 landing on the stun's first tick uncapped. endWhileNpc (T-078): in the same log a stun cast just before the enrage, the pathfinder (12220) up for its window, let shots of 25 and 27 through from the front where the cap is 10, and 25 is under the wound's minimum of 28: read as no stun while the pathfinder is up, until Eric says otherwise: the Leviathan's NPC_LEVIATHAN_01_STUN_01 (10282) plays every ~21 ticks in Eric's 2026-10-28 kill without a stun, so it is not the signal.

states.name: special
states.source: OSRS Wiki, read 2026-10-28: The Leviathan/Strategies: 'Damage dealt to the Leviathan is reduced by 33% for the duration of each special attack' (Lightning Barrage, Smoke Blast). Opened by NPC_LEVIATHAN_01_360_START (10285, the lightning barrage) or SPIT_START (10288, the smoke blast); closed by 360_END (10287), EXPLOSION_START (10290), or the volley's PROJECTILE_START/SINGLE (10278, 10281) once it is over. Eric's kill of 2026-10-28: 10285 at [1660] after a shot into the wound at [1657], volleys again from about [1705]; every hit between, 12 to 26, under two thirds of the 44 max.

modifiers.name: into the wound
modifiers.source: OSRS Wiki, read 2026-10-28 and 2026-10-29: The Leviathan/Strategies: 'When attacking the backside with ranged, it deals at least a minimum of ~65% of your maximum hit as damage' (no reference given). Read as a hit that cannot miss with that minimum. rollsFromMin and rolls 2 are a FIT, not a source (T-083): Eric's 73 wound shots of 2026-10-28/29 at a known max (each the shot landing 3 ticks before the special it sets off; 17 of them booked 'into the wound' by T-078's build) average 0.85 of the max, 37.6 at 44, and only 1 of 73 sits at the 65% minimum where max(roll, minimum) puts 29 of 45 rolls. Of the rules tried, drawn from the minimum to the max as the better of two rolls fits best with the wiki's 65% (38.6 expected per shot; the 17 booked ones 38.5 against 38.6); one draw gives 35.8, max(roll, minimum) 31.0, and two rolls raised to the minimum 33.1. A 60% minimum with two draws fits the 73 as well (37.9), so the 65% is kept as stated. Eric's kill: 33 at [1657] against a 44 max (65% is 28). Behind is the half-plane away from its facing: a guess, the wiki gives no geometry.

modifiers.name: into the wound

modifiers.name: special
modifiers.source: OSRS Wiki, read 2026-10-28: The Leviathan/Strategies: 'Damage dealt to the Leviathan is reduced by 33% for the duration of each special attack'. Read as two thirds, rounded down: the rounding is not stated.

modifiers.name: pathfinder
modifiers.source: OSRS Wiki, read 2026-10-28: The Leviathan/Strategies: the abyssal pathfinder 'has a 5x5 Area-of-Effect'; inside, the player is 'granted perfect accuracy and an increased minimum hit', Mod Ash (16 September 2023, cited there): 'If I'm reading my colleagues' code correctly, it's ensuring you hit for at least 20% of your max (...)'. rolls 2 is a FIT, not a source (T-079): in Eric's 288 pathfinder shots of 2026-10-28/29 (bow of faerdhinen 167, blazing blowpipe 121) landed hits averaged 0.67 of the max, rising to the top, where the minimum alone gives 0.52; the better of two damage rolls fits both weapons best (bow 28.1 per shot against 29.4, blowpipe 16.7 against 16.2 at its real max of 24) of the rules tried: the minimum alone, two or three rolls, a 35% minimum, a 25% or 30% boost. The wiki's 'increased accuracy and damage' (The Leviathan) does not say how. The npc is LEVIATHAN_BUFF_NPC (12220); the range is the wiki's radius marker, 'a Ranged attack range of 1 for normal Leviathan, or ... 2 for Awakened' (the awakened 7x7 is not modelled). Judged where the player stands when the attack goes out (Eric, 2026-10-28), inside on that tick and the one before (T-079: 9 of 52 enrages' first shots missed or hit under the minimum, a guess the MOD lines' tiles will settle). Outside it 'the player's attacks will deal less damage': by how much is not stated, so not modelled. Eric's kill: 7 of 7 enrage shots landed.

modifiers.name: pathfinder
modifiers.source: OSRS Wiki, read 2026-10-28: The Leviathan/Strategies: 'Attacking with magic instead of ranged while within the pathfinder's AoE will grant doubled damage instead of perfect accuracy.'

uptimeAllowances.source: T-074, approved by Eric 2026-10-29 (cap 7). Running behind the stunned Leviathan to shoot its wound is the mechanic (Eric, 2026-10-28 23:36). Measured over his 13 Leviathan logs of 2026-10-28/29 (87 stuns), idle ticks from the cast to the stun's end (the wound shot, or 15 ticks from the landing), with the cast and free shot counted as T-078 counts them: median 6, 75th percentile 7, 90th 9, most 15. The cap is the 75th percentile.

T-074, approved by Eric 2026-10-29 (cap 4). Dodging the Leviathan's lightning barrage and smoke blast, and getting back into position after. Over the same logs (61 specials), idle ticks inside the window and the 6 ticks after it: median 0, 75th percentile 4, 90th 7, most 17 (the smoke blasts alone: 75th 3; the barrages: 75th 4). The cap is the 75th percentile.

meleePunish.source: T-086. The wiki (Maggot King/Strategies): on a slam, players 'will automatically attack the boss without incurring an attack delay', clicking 'on the same tick that it extends its head'. 13925 is MAGGOT_KING_MELEEATTACK (gamevals). The 2 ticks are from Eric's log of 2026-10-29: of the 14 starts of 13925 it shows (beside the splats on Eric), 13 have an axe attack of his 2 ticks later. 9 of the 13 came before the axe's 5 ticks were up (899, 904, 909, 1406, 1431, 1436, 1441, 1446, 1914), and the axe's next attack came on its own cadence after each (1432 after 1427 and the punish on 1431), so the punish neither waits for the cooldown nor starts one. Booking only: what it does to accuracy and damage is T-087's.

states.name: slam
states.source: T-087. OSRS Wiki, read 2026-10-29: Maggot King/Strategies: 'During the slam, its magic defence is temporarily raised from +150 to +400' (the DPS calc's 'Nearby' version). The animation is a fit, not a source: in Eric's log of 2026-10-29 (pvm-debug-20261029-135031) the Maggot King's 13925 starts every 4 to 5 ticks in the melee phase only (below ~65% hitpoints, as the wiki has the slam), and 13 of Eric's melee attacks went out exactly 2 ticks after one, every one landing. How long the magic defence stays raised is not stated: 4 ticks, the slam's length to its punish tick and one after, is a guess.

states.name: punish
states.source: T-087. OSRS Wiki, read 2026-10-29: Maggot King/Strategies: a player who clicks 'on the same tick that it extends its head' attacks 'without incurring an attack delay' with 'increased accuracy (85% reduced defence roll if using crush) and a 50% damage boost for that attack'. The tick is a fit, not a source: in Eric's log every melee attack thrown 2 ticks into a 13925 (so landing 3 ticks in) hit, 13 of 13, against a 0.62 chance, and reached 75 against a 53 max.

So a burn splat on the King shows how many stacks it carries; with none for 4 ticks it carries none. Eric's log: burn splats of 1 to 5, four ticks apart.
